description: Returns how to get a broken web app tested and fixed with VibeFix: the link that starts a live test of the app by an AI agent (with the app's address filled in when given), the plans and the one-time credit pack with their prices, and what the person needs to provide. Read-only: it starts nothing, charges nothing and does not contact the app. Call it when the person wants the problem fixed, not only explained — for example after assess_broken_app.

url.description: The public URL of the deployed app, if known. Never a private or internal address.

name: get_fix_options
title: Get the options for fixing an app
